stable.headline: Notes are tasks: a title, a description, parts, who it is for, a priority and a due date, with comments under them, and they leave the app as CSV, JSON or BCF.
notes: A note is a task: a title, a description, the kind, who it is for, a priority and a due date, with comments under it.
Each kind has its own shape; finished notes are green and late ones are outlined in red.
A card for every part a note is about, with no limit; Focus selects the part and takes the camera to it.
Up to six screenshots per note, each remembering the view it was taken from.
Sign off a scene with Approve or Changes.
Take the notes out as a report, a spreadsheet, JSON or BCF for design tools, and bring them back in.
Save writes over the scene's file again after a restart.
A big STEP file with colours no longer stops the import.
